column4: SDXL, the diffusers multifolder packaging (unet / vae / text_encoder / text_encoder_2). Extracted from the served 3-shard tree, so shard-flattening is exercised by the reference itself.

SDXL-inpainting's UNet. A SEPARATE topology, and this is the whole point: its conv_in is [320, 9, 3, 3] where SDXL's is [320, 4, 3, 3]. v1 was shapeless and admitted it into the SDXL lane; here it cannot be confused with SDXL by construction.
Stable Diffusion 1.x UNet. Its proj_in/proj_out are rank-4 1x1 convs.
Stable Diffusion 2.x / SD-Turbo UNet. The SAME 686 keys as SD1.x, and use_linear_projection makes 32 of them rank-2 Linears where SD1.x has rank-4 convs. Two topologies, separated on shapes.
Anima's DiT under the `net.` spelling — what tensorhub/anima binds.
The same 685-tensor network under `model.diffusion_model.`, computed from the ratified rekey rather than extracted twice.
JoyCaption beta-one, 4 shards flattened into one component.
The same checkpoint with the SigLIP pooling head's MultiheadAttention q|k|v split — computed by inverting the ratified seam.
MusicGen stereo-medium, one flat fp16 file.

The native/DiffSynth spelling, one head-interleaved qkv_proj per block, computed from the ratified seam.
Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, bf16, 26 shards flattened.
The same network with self_attn.q_proj's head-major q|gate and linear_attn.in_proj_qkv's 1:1:2 q|k|v split out.
